Principle 14: My Future Dream Job
There are many jobs in the world, and it is very hard to choose only one.
I am still young, but I have read many different kinds of books
that have changed my mind many times already about what I want to be.
How can I choose among all of the great jobs like being a doctor,
movie star, and a lawyer?
Out of all these fantastic careers, my dream right now is to be a teacher.
I want to become a teacher for several reasons.
First, my schoolteacher sets a good example.
He loves children, and when I need help from him, he always helps me.
I want to be able to help others learn and grow, too.
He is excellent at teaching exactly what we need to know.
Second, my teacher knows a lot of things,
and shares his knowledge with us about many things all of the time.
I want to become a good teacher just like him.
In order to become a teacher,
my parents tell me that I need to study hard in all my subjects,
so I must go to a good university.
They also tell me that I need to love children and serve others.
I think teaching children is fun and rewarding,
and that I must have a lot of patience in order to teach them.
I know that one day I will be able to achieve my dream
and help many children learn and grow.
